question: Who is fit to receive the Kaula tradition without worldly elaboration?
premises: It is associated with those free from elaboration
The bound being is contrasted in this context
inference: The Kaula tradition belongs to those free from elaboration, not to the bound being.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of paśuḥ to the rest of the verse is compressed
plain_english: O Lord, O beloved, this is the Kaula tradition for those free from elaboration; for the bound being it is otherwise.
